title: Prescribed Frobenius in a prime-cyclotomic extension
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ. Let M be a finite-dimensional intermediate field of Ω/ℚ, and let F be an intermediate field of M/ℚ. Let q be a natural prime and ζ ∈ M a primitive qth root of unity. Assume that adjoining ζ to F inside M gives all of M. For every F-automorphism h of M and every finite set B of natural numbers, there exist a natural prime ℓ outside B and a valuation subring W of M such that ℓ is a nonunit of W and h preserves W and acts on its residue field by x ↦ x^ℓ.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ M] (F : IntermediateField ℚ M) (q : ℕ) (ζ : M), q.Prime → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ q → IntermediateField.adjoin F ({ζ} : Set M) = ⊤ → ∀ (h : M ≃ₐ[F] M) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ W : ValuationSubring M, W.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ W.IsFrobeniusAt h ℓ
